g.text: BJT output curves distinguish cutoff, forward-active behavior, and saturation

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Conceptual grounded-emitter NPN circuit with adjustable base drive; resistance and supply values are not assigned. Curves use an illustrative smooth knee
plus Early-effect tilt, not a full Ebers–Moll model. Active mode has forward-biased BE and reverse-biased BC; saturation forward-biases both. Cutoff
assumes negligible collector current and base injection.
